imageName.description: The name of the image file that the website will display. This should match the name of the image file being generated by Allsky.

showOverlayAtStartup.title: Show VirtualSky overlay at startup
showOverlayAtStartup.description: Whether to show the VirtualSky overlay when the page loads.

overlayWidth.title: Overlay Width
overlayWidth.description: The width in pixels for the VirtualSky overlay. Adjust this along with the Overlay Height and Offsets to get the best fit for your camera's field of view.

overlayHeight.title: Overlay Height
overlayHeight.description: The height in pixels for the VirtualSky overlay

overlayOffsetLeft.title: Overlay Offset Left
overlayOffsetLeft.description: The number of pixels to shift the VirtualSky overlay left (negative value) or right (positive value) to get the best fit for your camera's field of view.

overlayOffsetTop.title: Overlay Offset Top
overlayOffsetTop.description: The number of pixels to shift the VirtualSky overlay up (negative value) or down (positive value) to get the best fit for your camera's field of view.

az.title: Overlay Azimuth
az.description: The azimuth in degrees to rotate the VirtualSky overlay to match the orientation of your camera. This is used in combination with the overlay offsets and dimensions to get the best fit for your camera's field of view.

imageWidth.title: Image Width
imageWidth.description: The width of the image from Allsky

opacity.title: Image Opacity
opacity.description: The opacity of the Allsky image on the VirtualSky overlay. This can be adjusted to make the overlay easier to see or to better blend with the image.

og_description.title: Open Graph Description
og_description.description: The Open Graph description is used when sharing your Allsky page on social media platforms. It should be a brief description of your Allsky camera and what makes it unique.

og_type.title: Open Graph Type
og_type.description: The Open Graph type is used to specify the type of content being shared on social media platforms. For an Allsky camera page, 'website' is a common type to use.

og_url.title: Open Graph URL
og_url.description: The Open Graph URL is the canonical URL for your Allsky camera page. It should be the URL that you want people to visit when they click on the link to your Allsky page from social media platforms.

og_image.title: Open Graph Image URL
og_image.description: The Open Graph image is the image that will be displayed when your Allsky camera page is shared on social media platforms. It should be a URL to an image that represents your Allsky camera or the content of your page.
